title: Variables, Facts, Precedence, and Vault
objective: Place variables intentionally and protect secret material.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Values can come from defaults, inventory, host_vars, group_vars, plays, included files, facts, registered output, prompts, Vault, and extra vars. Avoid depending on obscure precedence when ownership can be explicit.
Facts describe managed systems and local facts extend discovery. Vault encrypts data at rest; decrypt only during execution and keep vault credentials outside the repository.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Place variables intentionally and protect secret material.

examples.title: Working design artifact
examples.code:

  shared_values: group_vars
  host_values: host_vars
  discovered_values: facts
  secrets: vault
